name: Extra Favored Enemy
body:
You have honed your skills against more favored enemies than most rangers.

Prerequisite(s): favored enemy class feature, ranger level 3rd.

Benefit(s): You designate one additional creature type or subtype as a favored enemy. Your bonus against this favored enemy begins at +2. Like your other favored enemy bonuses, this bonus may be selected to be increased at any level that you normally gain a new favored enemy (5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th).

Special: You can take this feat more than once, but no more than one additional time for every 4 ranger class levels you possess beyond 3rd.

Character Options: The Ranger. © 2025, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author: Bryan Mangum.
